whatIs: Kokonut UI is an open source library of 116 React components designed for AI apps, built with Tailwind CSS, Motion and shadcn/ui. It works as a shadcn registry: with one command, such as npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/particle-button, the component's code is copied into your repository.
It's a good fit when you already use shadcn/ui and want flashier pieces, such as animated buttons or chat input fields, that you can freely modify.
uses: Adding a prompt input box to an AI chat.
Adding animated buttons and cards to a landing page built with React.
Configuring the registry in components.json to install pieces by short name.
caveats: It requires a React project with Tailwind and shadcn/ui already set up.
The animations use Motion, so each component may add that dependency.
The more complete blocks, such as sections and templates, are part of a separate Pro version.
pricingNote: The library is free under the MIT license; the Pro version costs $119 as a one-time payment, with lifetime access.
idealFor: Developers using shadcn/ui who want animated components for AI apps.
